row.body:
My note from near lunchtime: the field trial crew carried sealed seed packet. my brother started coughing. I had not yet heard that the bridge was blocked.

I did not know where to put it after the shelves were cleared. There was still someone coming back for the answer written on it.

I could have mistaken the order in which those things happened. I could not mistake the empty place left for the person we had been waiting for.

row.body:
At closing I counted the remaining boxes and wrote the number on the lid. A driver came for them after I had put away the register.

He had a list of addresses, but it was folded so I could only see the first. He crossed it out without unloading anything. We waited until his radio called him away.

I was told to write the boxes off as spoiled. They were still warm when he took them, and I had eaten from the same batch.
row.title: Back door count

sidecar.gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
sidecar.rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
